badges.body: Learning support uses Socratic questions and vocabulary scaffolds. No one-click full-essay ghostwriting.
Data is de-identified before it is sent to AI. The ability chart is a classroom self-assessment reference, not a clinical diagnosis. No diagnostic labels or support lists appear in product chrome.
Designed to align with learning-support and smart-teaching directions. Not an EDB, Learning Support Grant (LSG), or HKEAA endorsement or certification.

footerDisclaimer: These are product commitment labels — not HKEAA, EDB, or any official seal or approval.
